The three-part DuPont breakdown shows **ROE recovered to 20.2% in FY2026 from 18.9% in FY2025, but remained well below FY2024’s 29.2%**.

- **Asset turnover:** Continued to decline, from 1.33× in FY2023 to 1.03× in FY2026. This indicates lower revenue generated per unit of assets and has partly offset the margin rebound.
- **Equity multiplier:** Stayed around 1.6× across the period, so leverage has been relatively stable and does not explain most of the year-to-year ROE movement.

**What stands out:** FY2026’s higher ROE came from improved profitability, not stronger asset utilisation or a material increase in leverage. The persistent asset-turnover decline is worth watching alongside whether margins can sustain their recovery.
